top.line: Sovereign Agentic Website: a website built by agents and owned by the person it is for.

in-short.line: The name, the promise, sovereign, agentic, open and hosted, and AgentiCCells as the company.

why.line: The website cell undersold it; AgentiCCells sells agentic teams, so the website gets its own brand.
why.para: To compete with WordPress and Wix.

words.line: Sovereign is the claim only we can make; agentic is what differs from the web of 2000.
words.para: Owned and movable; built and changed by agents.

open.line: An open pattern anyone can use without paying us, and a hosted version on sovereignwebsite.site.

today.line: The domains and the GitHub organisation are ours; the factory and the cell already make these sites.

acc.line: AgentiCCells stays the company selling agentic teams; SAW is one of its cells.

limits.line: Mock-ups are proposals; prices as published; sovereign means owning and moving.

sources.line: The website cell, factory, sovereignty and registrar pieces, and 19 November's decisions.
